name: @lovieco/company-formation
description: An MCP server for forming companies in the US.

LOVIE_API_KEY.description: Your Lovie API key, used to authenticate with the Lovie services.

MCP_SERVER_PORT.description: The port for the MCP server to listen on. Defaults to 3000.

tools.name: form_company
tools.description: Forms a new company in the United States.

company_name.description: The name of the company to form.

company_type.description: The type of company to form (e.g., 'LLC', 'C-Corp').

state.description: The state in which to form the company (e.g., 'DE', 'WY').

owner_name.description: The full name of the company owner.

owner_email.description: The email address of the company owner.

docker.description: Run the server using a pre-built Docker image from GitHub Container Registry.
